title: Project syllabus
description: The original project overview, assessment weights, and final design defense.
note: Adapt the pacing and standards alignment to your course.

title: How much land does food take?
description: Compare diets, calculate farmland, and support a claim with numbers.
note: Uses a class of six; change the multiplier for your group.

title: Where did your breakfast grow?
description: Use food labels, climate, and water to explain where crops grow.
note: Includes Spanish prompts and sentence starters. Science 1.3 repeats this worksheet and is omitted.

title: Garden field guide
description: Observe a garden and identify what limits plant growth.
note: Compare outdoor conditions with what the hydroponic system can control.

title: The six missing pieces
description: Match plant needs to the reservoir, pump, tubing, nutrients, drainage, and monitoring.
note: Includes Spanish prompts and sentence starters.

title: Vote and get ready
description: Choose a system job, define its criteria and constraints, and plan a first step.
note: Includes Spanish prompts and sentence starters.

title: How many tees do we need?
description: Build branching models and explain the relationship between outlets and tees.
note: Earlier design: eight direct feeds and a bypass. For the current four paired routes, use three supply tees and three return tees; no bypass is shown.

title: Plants make it. We burn it.
description: Photosynthesis and respiration, with video prompts, four corners, a sorting activity, and a backup quiz.
note: Open in a browser. Arrow keys move between slides; videos and photographs need internet. The old Kahoot PIN has been removed.

title: Plants make it, we burn it — worksheet
